name: farmer-runtime
comment: Minimal runtime dependency set for the production image. The web app and jobs are bundled into app.js by `bun build` (see Dockerfile); vite's SSR build (dist/server) bundles react/tanstack/base-ui/lucide/drizzle/postgres/etc. into itself. Only these packages survive as bare imports at runtime: better-auth + framer-motion/motion (vite leaves them external), the drizzle-orm + postgres peers better-auth's drizzle adapter resolves from node_modules. Keep versions in lockstep with apps/web/package.json + packages/core/package.json. docker/bun.lock pins the transitive graph and the image installs with --frozen-lockfile; without it every rebuild of the same commit resolved transitives fresh, so two builds of one tag were not the same image. Regenerate it whenever a version here changes, and do it WITH THE BUN THE IMAGE PINS (Dockerfile's BUN_VERSION, which tracks the root package.json's packageManager) rather than whatever bun is on your PATH. A newer bun can write a lockfile version an older one cannot parse (bun 1.4 writes lockfileVersion 2, which 1.3 refuses), and a lockfile the image's bun cannot parse fails the runtime install with 'Unknown lockfile version' followed by 'lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen'. This file is written from scratch each time, so there is no existing version for bun to preserve the way it preserves the root bun.lock's. mkdir -p /tmp/rt && cp docker/runtime.package.json /tmp/rt/package.json && (cd /tmp/rt && bunx bun@<BUN_VERSION> install --lockfile-only) && cp /tmp/rt/bun.lock docker/bun.lock.
